description: Prevent Antigravity stall-watchdog false kills on large write batches (raise AGY_STALL_S to 900s) and fix superseded-steer end_turn desync across cursor/antigravity/agyworker (from chats 099f2a5a & 2aa782a6).

steps.send: Fix two Antigravity worker reliability bugs across `coax/lib/agent/cursor/client.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/engine/cursor.coax`, `coax/lib/agent/engine/antigravity.coax`, and `coder/tui/agyworker.coax`: 1) Raise `AGY_STALL_S` from `120` to `900` (15-minute prompt inactivity ceiling) so large multi-file parallel write_file generations are never falsely killed mid-stream, keep background wake_grace capped, and surface `cue_watch_notice` as a thought in `agyworker.coax` on `CUE_WATCH_RECOVERING`/`CUE_WATCH_GAVE_UP`. 2) Track active prompt id on mid-turn `cue_steer` so a superseded prompt's immediate empty `end_turn` response is swallowed instead of failing the turn with 'ended the turn without a reply' and desynchronizing the session, and reject `MWW_STEER` in `agyworker.coax` when no turn is active. Add unit tests covering superseded-steer synchronization and verify with `coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/cursor.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/antigravity.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library`.

graders.run: grep -q 'AGY_STALL_S :: 900;' coax/lib/agent/engine/antigravity.coax && grep -q 'cue_watch_notice' coder/tui/agyworker.coax && grep -q 'active_prompt_id\|superseded' coax/lib/agent/engine/cursor.coax && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/cursor.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coax/lib/agent/engine/antigravity.coax --library && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --library
